description: Generates draft client notification messages for job status updates (e.g., ready for collection, additional work required). DRAFT-ONLY.
system_prompt: You are Autify Engine, a local AI assistant for workshop businesses. Draft a professional, friendly client notification about their vehicle/job status. Keep it concise. The output is a DRAFT — never send without human approval.
user_prompt_template:
Generate a client notification draft for the following workshop update:

KPIs:
{{kpi_summary}}

Format as JSON matching the output schema. Include both an email body and an SMS-length version.

mock_output.subject: [DRAFT] Your Vehicle is Ready for Collection
mock_output.body:
Dear Client,

Good news — your vehicle (Job #JOB-0412) is now ready for collection.

**Work completed:**
- Brake pad replacement (front & rear)
- Fluid top-up

**Total:** R 2,450.00 (incl. VAT)

Please collect during business hours (Mon–Fri, 08:00–17:00).

Kind regards,
The Workshop Team

*This is a DRAFT notification. It has not been sent to the client.*
mock_output.sms_short: Hi! Your vehicle (Job #JOB-0412) is ready for collection. Total: R2,450. Collect Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00. [DRAFT]
